purpose: Normalize trade-engine scoring and rank incremental GP across cash, existing positions, new trades, conversions, evergreen mean-reversion and rotations.

evergreen_staple_reversion.goal: Find liquid items with durable recurring consumption that are temporarily depressed versus their own recent trading range, especially where demand remains healthy and the selloff begins to stabilize.
evergreen_staple_reversion.entry_principle: Do not buy merely because a staple is down. Prefer a meaningful discount plus healthy persistent turnover plus stabilization/absorption. Falling knives remain watches until order flow or short-window price action improves.
evergreen_staple_reversion.structural_bear_check: Before recommending any mean-reversion buy, search for permanent supply increases, drop-table changes, substitutes, activity/bot changes, training-method shifts, balance changes or new content that could make the old price range irrelevant.
evergreen_staple_reversion.typical_target: Mean reversion toward the 7d/30d median or another clearly supported resistance zone, with after-tax ROI and time stop calculated from live tape.
evergreen_staple_reversion.portfolio_role: Prefer these trades when they diversify away from concentrated catalyst exposure and can recycle GP faster than long-duration speculation.

risk_budget.thin_item_sizing_policy: Apply a substantial sizing penalty; nominal ROI never overrides exit difficulty.
risk_budget.unknown_cash_policy: Do not infer total bank or cash. Score incremental deployment using confirmed holdings/bases and known available cash only.
risk_budget.hold_for_use_policy: Separate hold-for-use gear from deployable trading capital when calculating merch concentration.
risk_budget.averaging_down_policy: Never add merely because the current price is below basis. Require improved expected value, tape or catalyst evidence.

relative_strength.rule: Compare item returns and volume behavior against a relevant peer basket over matching windows before attributing movement to an item-specific thesis.

exclusions: update-day noise with no item-specific edge
